description: Use when the user asks about mail setup or why mail goes to spam (no reputation, content or blocklist checks). Returns MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM (your selectors) and a spoofing category. One domain per call; domain_health (needs an API key) adds DKIM discovery and MTA-STS. Ex: 'Check example.com'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

domain.description: A public domain name, e.g. example.com.
